method: For each region and year, divide monthly value by its 12-month mean, then average the three annual indices. Daily indices first divide by days in month. Min/max are between-year ranges, not confidence intervals.
warnings: 지역 방문객은 개별 가게 손님 수가 아니며 지역·월 합계는 중복 없는 고유 인원수가 아님
